verdict.rationale: uv is a CLI package manager, not an API service, so a true OpenAPI spec doesn't strictly apply, but docs claim a machine-readable llms.txt index and markdown-exportable docs pages as an 'equivalent' (uv-docs-52), plus a documented CLI reference (uv-probe-4). However, probes for actual OpenAPI/swagger endpoints and adjacent llms.txt/docs-md paths all returned 404 (uv-probe-1, uv-probe-2, uv-probe-3), leaving the claim thinly verified. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that docs.astral.sh/uv/llms.txt actually resolves, and any real OpenAPI/JSON schema for uv's own interfaces.
